title.narrative: UNDP Community Resilience and Development Programme
UNDP Community Resilience and Development Programme CRDP in West Bank

description.narrative: The objective of the CRDP is to empower local stakeholders, through civil society organizations to act with resilience to respond to threats that affect their sustenance on the land. The program will contribute to prevent a)Prevent the erosion of Palestinian Development in Area C and E. Jerusalem b)Protect Palestinian Land and thir property c) enhance human security.
